# Search and inquiry

## Purpose

**Search** (`/search`) is the primary **lookup** entry point for items, suppliers, sites, and related GOLD entities across roles.

**Inquiry** (`/inquiry`) provides deeper operational inquiry workflows (widgets vary by deployment).

## Who may use it

Most flags include **Search** (often via `ALL` on dashboard/search rules). Inquiry access follows the same flag bundles as buyer/helpdesk/IT.

## Typical analyst flow

1. Search by LU, EAN, supplier code, or description fragment.
2. Open linked maintenance screen (mass-change, Syndigo, or GOLD) if edit is required.
3. For natural-language questions, prefer [AI Assistant](functional/supply-chain-ai/ai-assistant.md) in AI mode.
